name: Calzone
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 4 ounces (115 g) any topping (such as ham, bacon, salami, pepperoni, and/or sausage) (optional)

steps: Combine ricotta, mozzarella, toppings, and oregano.
Roll the pizza dough between 2 pieces of waxed paper.
Spoon the cheese mixture into the center of the dough.
Moisten edges of dough slightly. Fold the dough over, and seal edges by pressing with a fork.
Bake until golden brown, about 10 or 12 minutes.

culture.text: Calzone is an Italian oven-baked folded pizza. A typical calzone is made from salted bread dough, baked in an oven and stuffed with prosciutto or salami, mozzarella or ricotta, and Parmesan or pecorino, as well as an egg. Different regional variations in or on a calzone can often include other ingredients that are normally associated with pizza toppings. The term usually applies to an oven-baked folded pizza rather than a fried folded pizza, although calzones and panzerotti are often mistaken for each other.
